alt: A product listing, products/p1.json for Pilot G2 gel pens, goes through an instructor + LiteLLM extraction that returns what it is (gel pen) and what pairs with it (ink refill, notebook); Neo4j stores Product and Taxonomy nodes joined by PRODUCT_TAXONOMY and PRODUCT_COMPLEMENTARY_TAXONOMY edges, editing p4.json re-derives only the notepad's node and edge, and a Cypher query that recommends for a gel pen returns the spiral notepad and the multi-purpose paper.

run.note: Explore it in Neo4j Browser (neo4j / cocoindex)
